column8: ["The plum housing has weight, but its broad, softly mottled surface feels generic; give the ceramic a more confident glaze character and purposeful edge treatment.","The orange seat rims and dark collars read as flat color bands rather than rubbed brass and matte rubber; distinguish their surfaces with richer tonal structure and contact wear.","Pale upper bevels and dark lower edges suggest directional lighting. Use symmetric curvature shading so the housing remains convincing when rotated.","The small central brass inset reads as a muddy dark recess; clarify its material and shape."]

["The plum housing has weight, but its soft, cloudy shading reads more like molded plastic than glazed ceramic; give the glaze clearer tonal structure and contact edges more deliberate wear.","The reddish seat rims lack a distinct rubber character, and the central brass fitting reads as a muddy brown lump. Separate their surface treatments so each material registers at gameplay scale.","The repeated bevel treatment dominates the painting; give the housing more purposeful crafted detail and character beyond outlining the three openings."]

["The plum housing feels uniformly mottled and soft; clearer ceramic glaze, rubbed brass rims, and matte rubber edges would give the materials more character.","Bright upper-left bevels and dark lower-right edges impose directional lighting that will visibly rotate with the machine.","The small square recess between the upper seats reads as a deep cup with a visible inner wall, weakening the straight-down view."]
